title: CodexReviewEvidence
description: One `codex review` attempt's provenance record (#750 Phase 1). Flattened rather than a JSON-Schema oneOf/discriminator: msgspec.Struct codegen has no clean discriminated-union output here, and this repo's own Receipt (review.py) already validates a flat dict by hand rather than requiring every composite type to round-trip through a generated union. `outcome` is the tag; the branch-specific fields (resolved_model/review_completion for `resolved`, unavailable_reason for `unavailable`, error_kind for `error`) are present and null when their branch does not apply. Every closed set here (outcome, review_completion, unavailable_reason, error_kind) is still generated, per this repo's standing rule that a closed set typed as a bare str fails silently. Phase 1 is record-only: this schema has no bearing on kb-ship/kb-land, which do not read it yet.

OutcomeKind.description: The tag. resolved: a unique reviewer turn was found and its model read. unavailable: looked properly and the evidence was not there (a data gap, not a bug). error: the resolver itself failed (I/O, a crash) while trying to look.

ReviewCompletion.description: Measured 2026-09-10 against real rollouts on this host: a completed AND an aborted review both write one event_msg of type task_complete to the CHILD rollout (last_agent_message + no error vs last_agent_message=null + an error object); a review still mid-flight or whose task_complete has not yet been flushed to disk leaves none, which is 'unknown', never silently read as complete.

UnavailableReason.description: Closed set of reasons collection or resolution could not produce evidence, none of them a resolver bug.

ErrorKind.description: Closed set of resolver-side failures — the resolver itself broke, distinct from an honest UnavailableReason.
